prTitle: FEATURE: Can edit category/host relationships for embedding
head: d1c69189f3c90ecf56013a8da904da9bff9a8e19

prOriginalConhecido.nota: No upstream PR: the benchmark head d1c69189 is itself a direct commit by Robin Ward on discourse/discourse main (committer date 2015-08-20, no associated pull request; gh pr search by title finds nothing), and it is an ancestor of main. The reference date is that commit's date.

tps.bug: EmbeddableHost's host format validation only accepts TLDs of 2-5 letters, so admins cannot add embeddable hosts on longer TLDs like example.technology.
tps.evidenciaOpus: The new EmbeddableHost model (app/models/embeddable_host.rb:2) validates hosts with `\.[a-z]{2,5}(:[0-9]{1,5})?`, rejecting TLDs longer than five letters such as .technology or .photography. The previous SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host? did plain string comparison with no format restriction.
tps.evidenciaAstra: The newly added validation in app/models/embeddable_host.rb:2 restricts the final suffix to 2–5 letters, rejecting example.technology. Both create and update invoke save_host, whose validated host.save rejects these relationships (app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:5–11,27–30); the previous hostname comparison imposed no suffix-length restriction.
